rationale: The only candidate (9f8043e16f2e) adds a feature (cascading SIGTERM to subprocesses) and just renames the blamed handler to a private _slurm_sigusr_handler_fn; it does not repair the configurable-signal logic.

9b5c5938ceb7 removes the get_device fallback this change added, but its message ('Remove get_device call') does not say whether the fallback caused a malfunction or simply became unnecessary once the bluetooth integration handled connected devices.

bd658441bd01 mainly adds a package_name parameter for standalone lightning-app packaging and swaps logger.info for print as a workaround ('check why logging.info is missing'); logger.info was already used before this change, which only added version numbers to the messages.

b8eaabe3c983 adds the interruptible-work feature and replaces the hard-coded internal placeholder preemptible=False with preemptible=self.interruptible, which extends the feature rather than fixing a defect.

cd8fced369d4 (a 'fix' the next day) replaces the hasattr(request, 'subdomain') check with the is_using_customer_domain helper and also turns on the customer-domains feature flag when a customer domain is used; it is unclear whether the old check behaved wrongly or whether this just completes the feature.
bf1323d138f6 is step 4 of a planned column migration that renames app_id_str back to app_id; the blamed app_id_str lookup was correct for its step and nothing is repaired.
e522a12d177f is a UX rework of lightning connect (progress bar, removal of the --yes option), and the blamed recursive connect() call changes only to drop the removed argument.

The fix repairs an iterate-over-None bug elsewhere, but in this file it only corrects the return-type annotation '-> str | None', which already existed before this change and was merely reflowed when the lineno parameter was added.

The change builds all_codes with np.arange(c.categories.nunique(), dtype=np.int8), which overflows for categoricals with more than 127 categories; the BUG fix drops the int8 dtype (the later ordered-to-sort edits change behaviour that predates this change).
6842cdcb65c6 is a clean-up of ZHA default entity names that removes the custom name property and the _name attribute in favour of _attr_name; it is a refactor, not a fix for the _attr_name override.
bf1323d138f6 is step 4 of a planned app_id to app_id_str migration and renames the column back to app_id; writing app_id_str in step 1 was intended and correct.

38bee5babc36, a same-day 'fix(backend): session replay banner setting', removes the new is_saas() helper (which reads settings.SENTRY_IS_SAAS), but the bundle does not show whether that setting was missing or wrong (e.g. AttributeError) or was just dropped for another approach.
